models._description: Adds IAP autocomplete/enrich query + provider-payload mapping methods
Auto-enrich the company on create; iap_enrich_auto_done flag
session_info adds iap_company_enrich flag for admins

behavioral_notes.observation: iap.autocomplete.api is an AbstractModel (no fields, no table) that is the egress wrapper for this module. _contact_iap(local_endpoint, action, params) lazily provisions env['iap.account'].get('partner_autocomplete'), refuses to proceed without account.account_token, then enriches params with db_uuid (ir.config_parameter database.uuid), db_version, db_lang, the account_token, and the requesting company's country_code + zip, before calling iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc(base_url + '/api/dnb/1/' + action). base_url is ir.config_parameter 'iap.partner_autocomplete.endpoint' defaulting to _DEFAULT_ENDPOINT 'https://partner-autocomplete.odoo.com' (a host distinct from the generic iap.odoo.com credit host), so a self-hosted proxy is a one-parameter override. If modules.module.current_test is set it raises ValidationError('Test mode') so tests never bill or hit the network. _request_partner_autocomplete catches ValidationError + iap_tools.InsufficientCreditError -> ('Insufficient Credit'), and ConnectionError/HTTPError/AccessError/UserError -> their message, returning a 2-tuple (results, error) so res.partner callers can degrade gracefully. The provider is DnB (Dun & Bradstreet) reached via the Odoo IAP broker; actions are search_by_name, search_by_vat, enrich_by_duns, enrich_by_gst, enrich_by_domain.

behavioral_notes.element: res.partner._format_data_company — mapping the provider payload onto res.partner
behavioral_notes.observation: Every IAP suggestion/enrichment dict is normalised by _format_data_company, which calls three resolvers that translate provider codes into Odoo records the form can write: _iap_replace_location_codes pops country_code/country_name + state_code/state_name and search()es res.country / res.country.state (case-insensitive), re-emitting them as {id, display_name} dicts; when base_address_extended is installed and the country enforce_cities, it also resolves a res.city by zip then name. _iap_replace_industry_code maps a DnB industry_code to an existing base.res_partner_industry_<code> xmlid -> industry_id. _iap_replace_language_codes maps preferred_language to an installed res.lang (specific e.g. fr_BE, else generic fr). VAT returned by enrichment is sanity-checked through _validate_partner_autocomplete_response (base_vat _run_vat_checks validation='setnull') so an invalid number is nulled rather than written. The logo is NOT downloaded inside this module: the provider returns image data carried as image_1920; res.company._enrich keeps only fields that exist on res.partner and are empty (except image_1920 which always overwrites) and writes them to partner_id. autocomplete_by_vat has a VIES fallback: if IAP returns nothing it calls stdnum check_vies and parses the VIES name/address block into a partner dict.

behavioral_notes.element: res.company.iap_enrich_auto / _enrich — automatic company self-enrichment on create
behavioral_notes.observation: res.company.create() calls iap_enrich_auto() (or, under current_test, just sets iap_enrich_auto_done=True). iap_enrich_auto, guarded so it only runs for a system user on a ready registry and not during demo install, iterates companies whose iap_enrich_auto_done is False and calls _enrich(), then flips the flag — a one-shot guard so a company is never enriched in a loop. _enrich derives the company domain from its email (via email_domain_extract, skipping generic _MAIL_PROVIDERS) or website (url_domain_extract, skipping localhost/example.com), calls res.partner.enrich_by_domain(domain, timeout=5), drops error responses, and writes back only res.partner fields that are currently empty (image_1920 excepted, always set), converting the {id,display_name} m2o dicts to bare ids first. ir.http.session_info() exposes iap_company_enrich = not company.iap_enrich_auto_done to admins so the web client can trigger the enrichment flow.

No local credit ledger exists in this module; spend is metered on the remote partner-autocomplete service. res.config.settings._compute_partner_autocomplete_insufficient_credit probes env['iap.account'].get_credits('partner_autocomplete') <= 0 to show an 'Insufficient credit' warning in Settings, and redirect_to_buy_autocomplete_credit returns an ir.actions.act_url to iap.account.get_credits_url('partner_autocomplete') (the hashed-token buy-more deep link into the Odoo IAP portal). A paid call that the server answers with InsufficientCreditError is surfaced by _process_enriched_response as {error:True, error_message:'Insufficient Credit'}; a plain error sets 'Unable to enrich company (no credit was consumed).' so the UI can tell a billed failure from a free one.

0 direct http_call_sites in this module (it never calls requests.post itself); SDK ['requests'] is transitive via iap_tools. uses_api_keys=False — auth is the per-account iap.account.account_token, not a global key. Endpoint: https://partner-autocomplete.odoo.com (overridable via ir.config_parameter 'iap.partner_autocomplete.endpoint'); the actual paid HTTP egress is brokered by the iap module's iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc. The upstream data provider behind the IAP service is Dun & Bradstreet (DnB), plus a VIES VAT fallback (stdnum check_vies) reached for VAT lookups.

5 JS files, 1 OWL component, 3 registry adds; bundles ['web.assets_backend','web.jsvat_lib','web.assets_unit_tests']. usePartnerAutocomplete (core) debounces typing (KeepLast), loads the jsvat lib to detect VAT/GST input format, and ORM-calls res.partner.autocomplete_by_name / autocomplete_by_vat as the user types; field_partner_autocomplete (char) and the PartnerAutoCompleteMany2one field widget render the suggestion dropdown (name, VAT, logo, address) and on select write the enriched values back; the partner_autocomplete.companyAutocomplete service drives whole-company enrichment. res.partner._get_view / res.company._get_view inject widget='field_partner_autocomplete' onto the name/vat/duns fields at view-render time so no XML view edits are needed.

it_architecture.application: partner_autocomplete (type-ahead company master-data enrichment: queries the Odoo IAP DnB/autocomplete service and maps the payload onto res.partner)
logical_data_erm: iap.autocomplete.api -> iap.account (get('partner_autocomplete') for token; AbstractModel, no own table)
res.partner -> res.country / res.country.state / res.city (resolved from provider location codes)
res.company -> res.partner (partner_id written with enriched data); iap_enrich_auto_done flag on res.company
information_flows: auth: params carry iap.account('partner_autocomplete').account_token + database.uuid + company country_code/zip
inbound-map: provider payload -> res.partner._format_data_company -> country/state/city/industry/lang resolved to Odoo records; image_1920 logo carried through
VAT path: autocomplete_by_vat IAP miss -> stdnum check_vies (VIES) fallback parses name/address; enrichment VAT re-checked via base_vat _run_vat_checks (setnull)
auto-enrich: res.company.create -> iap_enrich_auto -> _enrich -> enrich_by_domain -> write empty res.partner fields (+image_1920)
credit-gate: res.config.settings -> iap.account.get_credits/get_credits_url; InsufficientCreditError -> error_message surfaced to UI
frontend: OWL usePartnerAutocomplete (jsvat-detected name/VAT/GST) -> ORM autocomplete_by_name/by_vat -> dropdown -> write enriched partner
session: ir.http.session_info -> iap_company_enrich flag drives admin enrich prompt
frontend_components: PartnerAutoCompleteMany2one (res_partner_many2one field widget: company suggestion dropdown with name/VAT/logo/address)
field_partner_autocomplete (char field widget injected onto name/vat/duns via _get_view)
partner_autocomplete.companyAutocomplete (service: whole-company autocomplete/enrich, jsvat VAT/GST detection)

capabilities: Type-ahead company lookup by name, VAT, GST, DUNS or domain against an external data provider (DnB via IAP)
Map the provider payload onto res.partner (name, VAT, address, country/state/city, industry, language, logo)
Auto-enrich a newly created company from its email/website domain (one-shot)
Validate returned VAT (base_vat setnull) and fall back to VIES for VAT lookups
Gate the feature on remaining IAP credit and offer a buy-more redirect
Post a chatter enrichment note summarising the data received from DnB
value_streams: Type-to-Enrich: user types a partner name/VAT -> autocomplete_by_name/by_vat -> DnB suggestions -> select -> _format_data_company -> partner fields written
Create-Company-to-Enriched: res.company.create -> iap_enrich_auto -> enrich_by_domain -> empty partner fields populated from domain
information_concepts: DnB company record (name, VAT, address, industry, logo — external)
policies: iap_enrich_auto runs only for a system user on a ready registry, not during demo install, and only once per company (iap_enrich_auto_done guard)
modules.module.current_test -> _contact_iap raises ValidationError('Test mode'): never bills or hits the network in tests
_enrich writes only res.partner fields that are currently empty (image_1920 always overwrites)
returned VAT re-validated via base_vat _run_vat_checks(validation='setnull') before persistence
stakeholders: End user creating/editing a partner or company (consumes credits as they type)
System administrator (sees iap_company_enrich prompt; manages IAP credit/top-up in Settings)
Odoo S.A. IAP platform + Dun & Bradstreet (external data provider behind partner-autocomplete.odoo.com)
metrics: Remaining partner_autocomplete IAP credit (iap.account.get_credits; insufficient-credit warning)

classification.rationale: partner_autocomplete is a master-data enrichment utility, not a business object of its own value chain/shop/network — it owns no transactional model (1 declared AbstractModel iap.autocomplete.api with no table; the rest are res.partner/res.company/res.config.settings/ir.http inherits, 0 routes, 0 security records, ~791 py LOC). It is shared firm IT infrastructure (Porter support activity; Stabell & Fjeldstad 'support'): a type-ahead service that pulls company details (name, VAT, address, logo, industry) from an external Dun & Bradstreet provider through the iap broker and writes them onto existing partner/company master data. auto_install=true and category Hidden/Tools confirm invisible plumbing rather than a user-facing app. APQC 13.0 'Develop and Manage Business Capabilities' fits because the work is master-data management — populating and maintaining the quality/completeness of the partner master that every downstream process (sale, purchase, account, crm) reuses (13.x knowledge/data/information-asset management). 8.0 'Manage Information Technology' was considered (the sibling iap module sits there as the egress broker) but partner_autocomplete itself adds no IT-service plumbing — it consumes iap's broker, and its substance is enriching business master data, so 13.0 (master-data management) is the better fit; 11.0/3.0 were rejected as it neither owns finance/risk nor sells anything.

standard_capabilities: Type-ahead partner/company autocomplete by name, VAT, GST, DUNS, domain (DnB via IAP)
Provider payload -> res.partner mapping (country/state/city, industry, language, logo, VAT)
Automatic one-shot company self-enrichment from email/website domain on create
VIES VAT fallback + base_vat re-validation of returned VAT
Credit-aware UX: insufficient-credit warning + buy-more-credits redirect in Settings
Chatter enrichment note (iap_mail.enrich_company_by_dnb) summarising received data
typical_fits: Speeding up partner creation in Sales/Purchase/CRM by typing a company name and accepting suggested name/VAT/address/logo
Bootstrapping the user's own company record from its website/email domain at setup
Pointing the autocomplete at a private proxy by setting the iap.partner_autocomplete.endpoint parameter
common_gaps: Requires IAP credit + outbound HTTPS to partner-autocomplete.odoo.com; air-gapped deployments need a self-hosted endpoint and have no enrichment
Provider coverage is DnB-centric — non-listed/very small companies may return nothing
No local audit/ledger of what was enriched or how many credits were spent (metered remotely, gap #7)
Auto-enrich is one-shot per company (iap_enrich_auto_done) — re-enrichment needs manual action / flag reset
Mapping depends on installed res.country/state/industry/lang data; unresolved codes are silently dropped
drive_hints: odoo shell: env['res.partner'].autocomplete_by_name('Odoo', env.company.country_id.id)  # live DnB suggestions
odoo shell: env['res.partner'].autocomplete_by_vat('BE0477472701', False)  # VAT path (IAP then VIES fallback)
odoo shell: env['iap.account'].get_credits('partner_autocomplete')  # remaining credit for this service
odoo shell: env['res.partner']._format_data_company({'country_code':'BE','industry_code':'01','preferred_language':'fr_BE'})  # see the code->record mapping

open_questions: Exact DnB response schema / field catalogue lives on partner-autocomplete.odoo.com and is not reverse-engineerable from this module (gap #7).
Server-side per-call credit pricing/metering for the partner_autocomplete service is external (gap #7).
Whether deployments override iap.partner_autocomplete.endpoint to a private proxy (runtime config, not in code).
